This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Aldhani" />

==Biology and appearance==
This sentient species was distinguished by their leathery [[Color|tan]] skin, drooping facial flaps,<ref name="Aldhani" /> and sharp [[Tooth|teeth]].<ref name="One Way Out" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[5 BBY]], one member of this species was present at the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]],<ref name="Aldhani" /> while another member of this species was present within the [[Coruscant Underworld]], passing by [[spy]] [[Lonni Jung]] while he was heading to a secret meeting with [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="One Way Out" /> In [[3 BBY]], another member of this species was present at the [[Port Steergard|port]] at [[Steergard]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Fleshy-Flap-Faced-Species-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella]]
According to creature concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]]'s public portfolio, this species was first designed for {{Film|IX}},<ref name="Concept">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella - Creature & Character Designs|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop.com]|archivedate=20240604150100}}</ref> though it was never actually used in the film.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> Instead, this species would debut in the fourth episode of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]."<ref name="Aldhani" />
